# Subhadeep Ghorai

> Software Engineer at Newton School of Technology building LLM evaluation pipelines on the MERN stack, and a System Design instructor who has taught 500+ engineers (4.44/5 instructor rating across 569 student responses, 91.55% CSAT). Based in Kolkata, West Bengal, India. Seeking SDE and new-grad roles.

## Experience

- Instructor & Software Engineer, Newton School of Technology (Dec 2025 – Present): built and deployed LLM-powered evaluation pipelines (RepoScore-V2, WAP-Agent); delivered 100+ lectures across 10+ batches in System Design, OOP, Software Engineering and Design Patterns.
- Teacher Mentor & Senior Coding Instructor, Codingal (Dec 2023 – Jan 2026): mentored 100+ students across 10+ countries through 2,500+ live coding sessions; built Atlas, an internal operations platform for a 700+ teacher organisation; 4.46/5 rating, 80% renewal rate.

## Projects

- [EventLoop Studio](https://www.subhadeepghorai.in/work/eventloop-studio): VS Code extension, published on the Marketplace, that runs your own JavaScript in a real Node vm sandbox and replays the call stack, microtasks, timers and libuv phases step by step. Code: https://github.com/JACOBIAN01/EventLoop-Studio
- [SESD-Agent](https://www.subhadeepghorai.in/work/sesd-agent): three orchestrated Claude API pipelines that grade GitHub repos, case studies and coding streaks; 441 students graded in about 110 minutes. Code: https://github.com/JACOBIAN01/SESD-Agent
- [ADCMS](https://www.subhadeepghorai.in/work/adcms) (live: https://nst-ad.vercel.app): course platform where teachers evaluate students against an immutable GitHub commit history. Code: https://github.com/JACOBIAN01/Application-Development-Course-Management-System
- [Atlas](https://www.subhadeepghorai.in/work/atlas): internal operations platform that replaced a Google Form and Canva workflow; 168 certificates automated. Code: https://github.com/JACOBIAN01/Atlas

## Open source
